technical_and_design_decisions: Expose 'timeout' and 'pollInterval' as configurable global options within the Flo DSL parser and AST configuration model.
Upgrade Spring Integration dependency to release version 4.2.1 in root build scripts and resolve any deprecated API usages or minor breaking changes.
Profile 'JobLaunchingTasklet' to identify bottlenecks, reducing redundant database calls and optimizing job parameter handling during tasklet execution.
Implement parameterized unit and integration tests to validate DSL-to-XML and XML-to-DSL transformation variants.
Enhance the stream parser to recognize and preserve inline SpEL expressions across stream definitions for standard OOTB and custom modules.
Author comprehensive AsciiDoc/Markdown documentation on job orchestration guidelines, covering batch workflow construction and scheduling patterns.
Extend the YARN SPI state enum with 'UNDEPLOYED' and update app state conversion logic to map unmanaged container states correctly.
Modularize the 'admin' artifact by creating distinct Maven/Gradle sub-modules or packaging profiles for vendor-specific Hadoop distributions (e.g., CDH, HDP).
assumptions: Development work will be performed by a single developer familiar with the Spring Framework, Spring Batch, Spring Integration, and YARN SPI codebase.
Spring Integration 4.2.1 upgrade introduces minimal breaking changes that can be resolved quickly without requiring major architectural redesign.
Hadoop distro-specific dependencies can be decoupled via standard Maven/Gradle module splitting without major runtime classpath issues.
All work includes writing unit tests, running regression suites, and performing verification.

activities.activity_name: Implement Flo DSL global options for timeout and pollInterval (U1)
activities.activity_description: Update Flo DSL parser and underlying configuration properties to support 'timeout' and 'pollInterval' as global level overrides, including unit tests.
Update dependency versions to SI 4.2.1 across build scripts, adapt deprecated API calls, and verify compatibility with existing messaging components.
Analyze performance bottlenecks in JobLaunchingTasklet, optimize job execution context access, and refactor tasklet code to enhance performance.

activities.activity_name: Enhance test coverage for DSL and XML generation (U4)
activities.activity_description: Add new parameterized test suites covering various edge cases and generation variants for both DSL parsing and XML output.

activities.activity_name: Support inline SpEL expressions in stream definitions (U5)
activities.activity_description: Modify stream parsing and module payload handling logic to evaluate inline SpEL expressions consistently across all OOTB and custom modules.
Draft guidelines and technical documentation explaining job orchestration and batch workflow configuration with concrete examples.

activities.activity_name: Add UNDEPLOYED status to YARN SPI (U7)
activities.activity_description: Update YARN SPI status enum to include UNDEPLOYED state and adapt app status mapping logic from UNKNOWN to UNDEPLOYED.

activities.activity_name: Split admin artifact for Hadoop distro libraries (U8)
activities.activity_description: Refactor project build structures to split the core 'admin' artifact into vendor-agnostic core and distro-specific Hadoop modules.

activities.activity_name: End-to-end integration testing and build verification
activities.activity_description: Run total project build, perform integration testing across modules, fix minor regressions, and verify all user story requirements.
